text:
Iris: Hey team — spotted an odd metric on the per-model mini card: cache "savings" showing higher than the whole model cost for a few low-traffic routes (tenant O). Example: cost $0.06 vs savings $0.20. Screenshot in thread.
Dev: Hmm. Which view—explorer (24h) or billing?
Iris: Explorer 24h. Pulled a row from staging rollup: token_cost_24h=0.06, cache_credit_24h=0.20, sample_coverage=6%.
Luca: With coverage that low, sampling variance can blow up. Cache amortization can land entirely on a sampled span and make one cell look over-credited.
Priya: UX question: do we surface raw cache_credit_24h or should we show a derived, safer number by default? Users get worried if savings exceed cost.
Dev: I'm leaning backend-first: rollup should expose both raw windows (24h, 7d-amortized) + sample_count and provenance so clients can make smart displays. But console can still compute a friendly default.
Iris: Proposed quick UX: show "Estimated cache delta" = min(cache_credit_24h, token_cost_24h) when coverage <25% and surface a tiny "credence" badge (low/med/high) based on coverage. Clicking it shows provenance and links.
Luca: For determinism we should propagate sampled_span_id from router -> cache-cred pipeline so rollup joins are exact (long-term). I'll open RED-ENG-9200 for that.
Dev: Backend tasks: emit token_cost_24h, cache_credit_24h, cache_credit_7d_amortized, sample_count, rollup_version (RED-ENG-9201). Console tasks: compute estimated_display_savings behind FF, add credence badge and toggle to view raw vs canonical (RED-ENG-9202).
Priya: Microcopy: "Estimated cache delta (clamped). Based on sampled telemetry; click for confidence and amortization basis."
Iris: Also add a non-billing QA alert: if cache_credit_24h > token_cost_24h * 2 && sample_coverage < 30% -> file an ops ticket. That will catch spikes to investigate.
ops-bot: Created issues RED-ENG-9200, RED-ENG-9201, RED-ENG-9202 and queued RED-ENG-9201 for triage.
Dev: Rollout plan: land rollup fields first in staging -> console behind FF -> canary 10 tenants 48h -> expand. Priya will own console copy and screenshots.
Luca: I'll draft the rollup SQL to compute both windows and sample counts. Quick sketch: SELECT tenant, route, SUM(cost) FILTER (WHERE window >= now()- interval '1 day') AS token_cost_24h, SUM(cache_credit) FILTER (WHERE window >= now()- interval '1 day') AS cache_credit_24h, SUM(cache_credit) FILTER (WHERE window >= now()- interval '7 day')/7.0 AS cache_credit_7d_amortized, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sampled = true) AS sample_count FROM econ_events GROUP BY tenant, route.
Priya: Great. We'll default explorers to the clamped estimate and keep billing pages showing canonical amortized values. Add a small toggle so power users can opt into raw numbers.
Iris: Thanks — I'll attach tenant samples to RED-ENG-9201. Meeting to check canary metrics tomorrow 11:30.
